sloka: ततः प्रहृ^इष्ट वदनः सुग्रीवः लक्ष्मणाग्रजे ।वैरस्य कारणम् तत्त्वम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे ॥४-८-४६॥
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛ^iṣṭa vadanaḥ sugrīvaḥ lakṣmaṇāgraje ।vairasya kāraṇam tattvam ākhyātum upacakrame ॥4-8-46॥

translations.english: With a smile on his face, Sugriva started narrating to Lakshmana's elder brother the facts about the cause of his enmity (with Vali). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः Thus ends the eighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
